variant.label: S3 / 単体への反復映像

segments.label: 接触 1 / f1085
segments.notes: Thin continuous gold line from emitter to target; orange annulus and purple target flash. Initial connection is outside the close-up crop; this is first visible target contact.

segments.label: 接触 2 / f1110
segments.notes: Thin continuous gold line from emitter to target; orange annulus and purple target flash. Renewed muzzle ring distinguishes this attack beat from residual target flicker.

segments.label: 接触 3 / f1126
segments.notes: Thin continuous gold line from emitter to target; orange annulus and purple target flash. Renewed muzzle ring distinguishes this attack beat from residual target flicker.

segments.label: 接触 4 / f1234
segments.notes: Long fourth-coin beam reaches target; later beam flicker and renewed muzzle burst are part of this same channel.

notes: S3の別撮影であり新しい技ではない。Charge数値と分岐条件は映像から確定できない。既存S3の撮影は流用しない。 直接呼出し試作を追加。通常入力・Charge分岐は未接続。

verification.reason: 立方体の輪郭を円形へ改善。発光のにじみ、位置、周囲の軌跡、腕姿勢、カメラは未一致。通常入力・Charge分岐の未接続も残る。
